[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | region = Kryta | ingame name=Majesty's Rest | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=060 }} [[Majesty's Rest]] is a remote area that marks the transition between [[Kryta]] and the [[Maguuma Jungle]]. One of the game's most powerful foes, [[Rotscale]], makes his [[The Mausoleum (landmark)|home]] outside [[The Mausoleum]]. The [[Scepter of Orr]] was hidden in one of the buildings within this area until the [[White Mantle]] recovered it. ==Getting there== From Kryta, either leave from [[Temple of the Ages]] and head west through [[the Black Curtain]] and [[Talmark Wilderness]] or from [[Fisherman's Haven]] and travel north through [[Stingray Strand]] and [[Tears of the Fallen]], then northwest through Talmark Wilderness. From the Maguuma Jungle, leave from [[the Wilds (outpost)|the Wilds]] or [[Druid's Overlook]] and head east/northeast (respectively) through [[Sage Lands]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s:
